title: 第170章 这不是畜生吗？
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

赵可儿正在算账，头也没抬地说道，“厨房大冰柜里那么多东西，你们想吃什么自己拿一袋，剪开解冻就行了。管饱。”

黄毛和紧身衣男同时一愣。

紧身衣男挠了挠头，客套了一句，“也行吧。老板你们吃吗？我给你们也热几袋虾饺？今天这虾饺出餐率挺高的。”

“我们不吃。”

林雪摆摆手，拿起手机和日料犒劳一下。”

空气安静了两秒。

黄毛张了张嘴，没发出声音。紧身衣男脸上的笑容僵住。

两人对视一眼。默默缩回了厨房。

“哐当。”

厨房门关上。

黄毛脸上的假笑瞬间消失，拉下脸骂了一句，“草。”

紧身衣男走到冰柜前，拉开柜门，看着里面堆成山的彩色塑料包装袋。

“这三个娘们真他妈不是个玩意。”

黄毛靠在操作台上，压低声音嘀咕，“让咱们吃这预制菜，她们自己点日料？这也没把咱们当人啊。”

紧身衣男抽出一袋“秘制小笼包”，翻过来看了一眼背面。

密密麻麻的黑字。

“脱水蔬菜、复配水分保持剂、三聚磷酸钠、谷氨酸钠……”

紧身衣男念了几个词，停顿了一下，“好家伙，这是元素周期表开会呢？”

黄毛冷笑一声道，“可不是嘛。这不是畜生吗？真不拿咱俩当人啊。”

两人敢怒不敢言。毕竟工资还没结。

黄毛站在操作台前，手里拿着一把剪刀，看着案板上那堆彩色塑料袋。他摸了摸瘪下去的肚子，咽了一口酸水。

紧身衣男靠在门框上，往大堂方向看了一眼，压低声音骂道，“真他妈抠门。一天卖了这么多，中午自己点日料吃三文鱼，让咱们啃这些预制菜。老子在电子厂都没受过这委屈。”

黄毛把剪刀拍在案板上，冷笑一声，“咱们来干活是图口饭吃。她们不拿咱们当人，也别怪咱们手黑。”

Page (1/3)

Zhao Keer was settling the accounts and said without raising his head, "There are so many things in the big freezer in the kitchen. You can take a bag of whatever you want to eat, just cut it and defrost it. Just take care of yourself."

Huang Mao and the man in tights were stunned at the same time.

The man in tights scratched his head and said politely, "That's okay. Boss, do you want to eat? I'll heat up a few bags of shrimp dumplings for you too? The order rate for these shrimp dumplings is quite high today."

"We won't eat."

Lin Xue waved her hand, picked up her mobile phone and some Japanese food to reward her."

The air was quiet for two seconds.

Huang Mao opened his mouth but made no sound.The smile on the man in tights froze.

The two looked at each other.Silently retreated into the kitchen.

"Clang."

The kitchen door closes.

The fake smile on Huang Mao's face disappeared instantly, he lowered his face and cursed, "Fuck."

The man in tights walked to the freezer, opened the door, and looked at the mountains of colorful plastic bags inside.

“Those three bitches are no fucking shit."

Huang Mao leaned on the operating table and muttered in a low voice, "Let us eat these pre-made dishes and they order Japanese food themselves?This doesn't treat us as human beings."

The man in tights pulled out a bag of "Secret Xiao Long Bao" and turned it over to take a look at the back.

Densely packed black characters.

"Dehydrated vegetables, compound moisture retaining agent, sodium tripolyphosphate, sodium glutamate..."

The man in tights read a few words and paused, "Good guy, is this a meeting on the periodic table of elements?"

Huang Mao sneered and said, "That's not true.Isn't this a beast?You really don’t treat us as human beings."

The two dared not speak out in anger.After all, the salary has not been paid yet.

Huang Mao stood in front of the operating table, holding a pair of scissors in his hand and looking at the pile of colorful plastic bags on the chopping board.He touched his deflated belly and swallowed a mouthful of sour water.

The man in tights leaned against the door frame, glanced in the direction of the lobby, and cursed in a low voice, "You're so damn stingy.After selling so much in one day, I ordered Japanese food and salmon for lunch, and let us eat these pre-made dishes.I have never suffered this kind of injustice in the electronics factory."

Huang Mao slapped the scissors on the chopping board and sneered, "We come to work to make a living.They don't treat us as human beings, so don't blame us for being dirty."
